events.title: Leonardo: SLURM issues solved
events.body: Dear users, The issue on Leonardo that was causing jobs to be cancelled shortly after starting has been resolved. The cluster has been continuously monitored since then, and the situation is now stable. Production has been fully restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. King regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo: scheduled maintenance on May 26th
events.body: Dear Users, This is to inform you that Leonardo will be under maintenance on Tuesday, May 26th. During the maintenance operations both Booster and DCGP compute nodes will not be available. The login nodes might be temporarily unavailable during the morning operations while Datamovers will stay up and running during all day. We expect to bring the cluster in production within the… Source

events.title: Leonardo: SLURM issues still ongoing
events.body: Dear users, we are sorry to notice that some issues on the SLURM scheduler are still affecting running jobs on Leonardo, that may get “CANCELLED by 0” immediately after their start. We are working on it and we will get you updated as soon as possible. King regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo: slurm controller issues SOLVED
events.body: Dear Users, the issues encountered last week on the Leonardo slurm controller have been solved, and the scheduler is fully back in production. We apologize for any inconvenience caused, Best regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo: update on slurm controller issues and FAST storage resolution
events.body: Dear Users, we would like to provide an update regarding the issues currently affecting Leonardo. The problem on the $FAST filesystem has now been resolved, and the area is operating normally again. However, we are still experiencing intermittent issues with the Slurm controller, which may temporarily become unresponsive. As a consequence, job submission and monitoring commands may… Source

events.title: Leonardo: issues on slurm controller and on FAST storage
events.body: Dear Users, we would like to inform you that we are experiencing intermittent issues with the slurm controller on Leonardo, resulting in moments of unresponsiveness. We are also working on fixing the issues emerged yesterday on the accounting procedure (Leonardo: accounting procedure issue). Today we also encountered a problem on the $FAST area, causing all operations – such as git… Source

events.title: Leonardo: accounting procedure issue
events.body: Dear Users, We are experiencing some problems in the accounting procedure on Leonardo: as a consequence, today many accounts are showing a different amount of consumed budget than the expected. This may result in a presumed budget expiration and the inability to start new jobs because of “account expired”. We are currently working to fix the problem and we will keep you updated. Meanwhile… Source

events.title: Leonardo: issue with $WORK storage area SOLVED
events.body: Dear users, This is to inform you that issues with the $WORK area on Leonardo have been solved. Please note that, despite what was previously announced, jobs that were running in filesystems other than $WORK may have been also impacted by the malfunction during this time. We apologize for the inconvenience. Best regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: Leonardo: issue with $WORK storage area
events.body: Dear users, this is to inform you that we are experiencing issues with the $WORK area on Leonardo, that are having strong impact on I/O operations with files and jobs running on that area. We will update you when there will be updates about the situation. We apologize for the inconvenience. Best regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: Leonardo Booster back in production
events.body: Dear Users, The Booster partition has been restored to service. As outlined in the previous communication, the subnet manager issues responsible for node communication problems on Leonardo have been resolved, and the system is now operating in a stable condition. Best regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Access restored for Leonardo and DCGP back in production
events.body: Dear users, The vulnerability issue that impacted production yesterday, April 30th, is resolved also on Leonardo. The cluster is now accessible but it is operational on the DCGP partition only. The subnet manager issues causing the node communication problems on Leonardo have also been solved and the system state is currently stable. The booster partition is expected to resume production… Source

events.title: Leonardo: Node communication Issues Update
events.body: Dear Users, We inform you that the subnet manager issues causing the node communication problems on Leonardo have been solved and the system state is currently stable. We will continue monitoring the situation and in case we observe instability we will inform you. We apologize for the inconvenience. Best regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo: Node Communication Issues
events.body: Dear Users, We regret to inform you that the mitigation measures applied did not work as expected. During the night, issues were detected with the subnet manager, leading to the reappearance of node communication problems and the subsequent removal of several nodes from the production partitions. Unfortunately, as a consequence, many running jobs failed. As a result… Source

events.title: LEONARDO: slurm issues SOLVED
events.body: Dear Users, The root cause of the communication issues that led to job failures has been identified and mitigated, and the overall system state appears to have recovered. As previously announced ahead of the maintenance, additional fixes and post-maintenance activities are still in progress and are expected to be completed by the end of today. No critical impact on production is expected… Source

events.title: LEONARDO: slurm issues
events.body: Dear users, We are currently experiencing node communication issues following recent maintenance, which are causing some jobs to crash. We will provide an update as soon as more information is available. Best regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: Leonardo maintenance UPDATE
events.body: Dear Users, The operations to resolve the issues that arose last Friday, April 24th, are still ongoing. At present, it is not possible to run jobs on the whole cluster. We will provide updates as soon as the issues are resolved and Leonardo returns to production. We apologize for the inconvenience, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo maintenance extended to April 27th
events.body: Dear Users, We apologize for the inconvenience, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Reminder Leonardo Scheduled Maintenance (April 20–24)
events.body: Dear Users, this is to remind you that Leonardo will undergo a maintenance period from next Monday, April 20th to Friday, April 24th, because of an important system upgrade. From April 20th to April 24th, the system will be in production downtime, and both Booster and DCGP compute nodes will not be available. During this period, access to storage and datamover services will be… Source

events.title: Leonardo Scheduled Maintenance (April 20–24)
events.body: Dear Users, this is to inform you that Leonardo will undergo a maintenance period from Monday, April 20th to Friday, April 24th, because of an important system upgrade. From April 20th to April 24th, the system will be in production downtime, and both Booster and DCGP compute nodes will not be available. During this period, access to storage and datamover services will be maintained. Source

events.title: Leonardo: Booster Nodes Fully Restored to Service
events.body: Dear Users, We are pleased to inform you that the cooling system issue affecting a section of the Booster partition has been successfully resolved, and all previously unavailable nodes — specifically lrdn[1801–2700] are now fully back online. The Booster partition has returned to 100% operational capacity, and normal scheduling and workload distribution have resumed. We thank you for your… Source

events.title: Leonardo: Maintenance Completed
events.body: Dear Users, We inform you that the scheduled maintenance has been successfully completed. The DCGP partition is now fully back in production, while the Booster is currently available at approximately 70%. Full availability of Booster will be restored over the next few hours. Best regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: REMINDER: Leonardo scheduled maintenance tomorrow March 25th
events.body: Dear Users, we remind you that Leonardo will undergo scheduled maintenance tomorrow March 25th, starting at 9:00 AM. The system is expected to return to full production within the afternoon of the same day. Login nodes and datamover services will remain available throughout. Best regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: CINECA HPC authentication services restored
events.body: Dear users, This is to inform you that CINECA HPC authentication services are fully restored and operational. The access to CINECA HPC clusters and HPC Cloud (Leonardo, G100, Pitagora, EFGW and ADA Cloud) is now available again, as well as the access to CINECA HPC GitLab instance. We take advantage of this news to also inform you that the scheduled maintenance on the Leonardo system… Source

For this reason it is not possible to authenticate to the SSO portal and hence to access CINECA HPC clusters and HPC Cloud (Leonardo, G100, Pitagora, EFGW and ADA Cloud). For the same reason, the access to CINECA HPC GitLab instance is prevented. We will inform you as soon as the service… Source

events.title: Scheduled Maintenance Notification on March 24 – Possible Temporary Access Disruptions on Leonardo
events.body: Dear Users, a scheduled system upgrade will take place on Tuesday, March 24, in the morning. During this time, you may experience temporary issues accessing the Leonardo system. Services will be restored as soon as the maintenance is completed. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo: full booster availability restored
events.body: Dear Users, This is to inform you that the site operations on Leonardo are completed and the cluster is back to full production. Best regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.body: Dear Users, we would like to inform you about two upcoming events affecting the Leonardo system: Today, March 17th – Ongoing Partial Unavailability Due to site operations at the facility, Leonardo is experiencing a partial downtime starting from 7:00 AM CET today. Approximately 25% of the Booster partition is currently offline until the end of the operations. The rest of the cluster… Source

events.title: LEONARDO job submission issue SOLVED
events.body: Dear users, the problem with the management storage of Leonardo and job submission and execution are possible again. The cluster is back in full production. Regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: LEONARDO job submission issue update
events.body: Dear users, the issues on the management storage are continuing, and at present job submission on Leonardo is not possible anymore. The jobs that were already running are not affected, but jobs currently in queue cannot enter in execution. We will update you as soon as the issue will be solved. We aplogize for the inconvenience. Regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source

events.title: LEONARDO: management storage issues
events.body: Dear Users, we would like to inform you that we are experiencing issues with the management storage on Leonardo. Due to this, we encountered temporary problems with job submission, now resolved. The situation will be soon back to complete stability. We will inform you as soon as everything will be solved. We apologies for the inconvenience. Best regards, HPC User Support @ Source

events.title: Leonardo and G100 : Short unavailability of Datamover service on Monday March 2
events.body: Dear Users, On Monday morning, maintenance will be carried out on the Leonardo and G100 datamovers from 9:00 to 10:00 (CET). During this time interval, the service will not be accessible and any ongoing transfers will be interrupted. Best regards, HPC User Support – CINECA… Source
